title: Stacked-PR advice: handled by the Stack Nudge workflow, not the advice.js advice comment
answers: Where is the 'Not a GitHub stack' message handled now?
How do I change the wording or trigger of the stacked PR recommendation?
Why did the advice comment stop mentioning stacked PRs?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge job handles the stacked-PR recommendation for PR open and edit events, keyed on the 🥞 Stacked PR phrase in the PR body.
Rule: The stacked-PR message was moved out of .github/workflows/advice.js (its STACKED_PR_SECTION check and the "Not a GitHub stack" block were removed). To change that recommendation's text, trigger, or author gating, edit stack-nudge.yml rather than advice.js.
Constraints: advice.js still builds the other advice sections (for example media and UI-file checks); only the stacked-PR part moved.
applies: Anyone looking for where stacked-PR guidance on pull requests is produced in the repo's workflows.
says: Update the wording and trigger conditions for the stacked pull request recommendation comment.
The general automated advice comment on pull requests no longer mentions stacked pull requests.
Change author eligibility criteria for receiving automated suggestions about stacked pull requests.
search: Stacked-PR recommendations for pull requests are handled by the nudge job in .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml, not by .github/workflows/advice.js. The stacked-PR message, its STACKED_PR_SECTION check, and the 'Not a GitHub stack' block were removed from advice.js. To modify the stacked-PR recommendation text, trigger phrase ('🥞 Stacked PR'), or author gating, edit stack-nudge.yml rather than advice.js. The advice.js script still builds other advice sections such as media and UI-file checks.
